# Cristian Correa

> Data & AI Engineer. Statistician and software engineer building production AI systems and data platforms. Creator of Kebo. Based in Bogotá, Colombia.

## Summary

Cristian Correa (sometimes "Cris Correa" or just "Cris") is a software engineer and statistician with 8+ years of experience across fintech, ed-tech, ad-tech, and journalism. He builds AI products and data platforms, and ships production AI/ML systems with LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows.

- **Name:** Cristian Correa
- **Role:** Data & AI Engineer, Software Engineer, Statistician
- **Location:** Bogotá, Colombia
- **Site:** https://cris.fast
- **Email:** cristian.correa.cs@gmail.com

## Currently

- **Kebo** (https://kebo.app) — Open-source AI agent for personal finance. Main project since August 2024. 20k monthly active users, 100k+ downloads, 80k users across LATAM.
- **Crafter Station** (https://crafterstation.com) — Product engineering, since October 2025. Lima-based studio.
- **Independent consulting** — AI products and data platforms. Past clients include El Tiempo, Spectrum Reach, Nubank.

## Experience

### Independent Consultant — AI, Data & Product
*Nov 2023 – Present*
AI products and data platforms. Selected clients: El Tiempo, Spectrum Reach, Nubank.

### Platzi — Data & Analytics Engineer
*May 2022 – Apr 2023*
Led dbt project structure and CI/CD. Migrated the data warehouse from Redshift to BigQuery. Built an offline feature store that cut model training time in half.

### Rappi — Data & Analytics Engineer (Partner)
*May 2020 – May 2022*
Built the data foundation for Rappi Ads. Insights from that platform drove a 50% reduction in churn and 6× revenue growth in 1.2 years.

### Azzorti — Data & Analytics, SAP BI
*Oct 2018 – Jun 2020*
SAP BW / HANA implementations, BusinessObjects reporting, and a PHP–R integration over SOAP.
